## Summary

Implemented the minimum source-supported **Cliffs interconnect provider** for the G2 SD-only SDHCI DTS and rebuilt/validated the G2 DTB compile candidate. Opened **PR #19** (OPEN, not merged) on branch `opencode/g2-c-0002-cliffs-interconnect`.

**Interconnect IDs/topology corrected to source-verified Cliffs values** (not SM7635/Milos, not SM8550/SM8650):

| Endpoint | Cliffs (this work) | Prior SM7635/Milos |
|---|---|---|
| `MASTER_SDCC_2` | **47** (`0x2f`) on `aggre1_noc` | 8 on `aggre2_noc` |
| `SLAVE_EBI1` | **512** (`0x200`) | 1 |
| `MASTER_APPSS_PROC` | **2** | 2 |
| `SLAVE_SDCC_2` | **542** (`0x21e`) | 20 |

**Files changed:** `dts/qcom,cliffs.h` (new header), `dts/g2-cliffs-interconnect.dtsi` (new NoC compatibles `qcom,cliffs-*`), `dts/g2-sdhci-milos-merge.dtsi → g2-sdhci-cliffs-merge.dtsi` (Cliffs topology), `scripts/validate-g2-sdhci-provider-map.py` (rewritten 31/31), `docs/...` (result report + provider-map correction).

**Validation at `73e3f0710014fe6d4ed98cfc02292f6121db7558`:**
- Known-good `milos-fairphone-fp6.dtb`: **PASS** (69126 B)
- G2 `g2-sdhci-compile-test.dtb`: **PASS** (51888 B); disassembly confirms `interconnects = <aggre1_noc 0x2f 0x07 mc_virt 0x200 0x07>, <gem_noc 0x02 0x03 cnoc_cfg 0x21e 0x03>` + `qcom,cliffs-*` compatibles
- Provider-map validator: **PASS** (31/31)

**Exact first error (pre-existing baseline):** `vreg_l13b`/`vreg_l23b` undefined in the SoC DTSI — regulators left as explicit UNRESOLVED items (G2 = PMXR2230, no upstream provider).

**Next blocker:** PMXR2230 LDO13/LDO23 regulator provider.

**Blocked/deferred:** CI workflow update could not be pushed — `GITHUB_TOKEN` lacks the `workflows` scope (validator/build run locally instead); needs a maintainer with PAT.

**Safety:** build-side only — no device/SD/partition touched; PR left unmerged. Trace `automation/status:dispatch/trace/G2-C-0002-R1.json` matches run_id `33152767424`.
